cut: The Brink 2, DRAFT v1 (22 Oct) — one question: when does a temporary law stop being temporary?
argument: Finland's temporary border law of 2024 has never been used. It was extended once, and now two more years are proposed, unchanged; a committee agreed. Never used, still temporary, proposed until 2028.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: When does a temporary law / stop being [temporary]?
text.ja: 一時的な 法律は / いつ [一時的] で なくなる？

text.en: 2024: Finland passed / a temporary border law / for [one year].
text.ja: 2024年、 フィンランドは / 一時的な 国境法を 制定。 / 期限は [1年]。

captions.source: The Act on Temporary Measures to Combat Instrumentalised Migration (the Border Security Act) took effect on 22 Jul 2024 for one year (EUAA; Finnish Government; Edilex on HE 148/2026). Re-checked 22 Oct (plan/films/19-break-glass.md).

text.en: It has [never been used]. / In 2025 it was extended / to the end of 2026.
text.fi: Sitä ei ole [koskaan käytetty]. / Vuonna 2025 sitä jatkettiin / vuoden 2026 loppuun.
text.ja: 一度も [使われていない]。 / 2025年、 2026年末まで / 延長された。

captions.source: Never applied: the Finnish Government's and the Interior Ministry's situation pages (applying it would need a separate decision); Helsinki Times and others on the 2026 proposal. Extended to 31 Dec 2026 by Parliament on 4 Jun 2025, 168–29 (Eduskunta press release; EUAA).

text.en: Now proposed: two more years, / unchanged. In October, / a committee [agreed].
text.fi: Nyt esitys: kaksi vuotta lisää, / sisältö ennallaan. Lokakuussa / valiokunta [puolsi].
text.ja: 今度は 内容 そのままで / 2年 延長を 提案。 10月、 / 委員会が [了承]。

captions.source: Government proposal of 3 Sep 2026 (HE 148/2026, number single-source): validity to 31 Dec 2028, no changes to the content (Finnish Government; Edilex). Constitutional Law Committee statement, 16 Oct 2026: it can be enacted as an exception to the Constitution and is necessary; two members (Greens, Left Alliance) dissented (Yle, Kaleva/Uutissuomalainen, Demokraatti, Verkkouutiset). The plenary vote is still to come.

text.en: Never used. Still temporary. / Proposed: until [2028].
text.fi: Ei käytetty kertaakaan. / Yhä väliaikainen. / Esitys: [vuoden 2028] loppuun.
text.ja: 一度も 使われず、 なお 一時的。 / 提案は [2028年] まで。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: the emergency case with its glass whole, snowed over, and its validity tag rewritten 2025, 2026, 2028. 'Proposed' stays until the plenary vote passes; then 'Now until 2028' (IDEAS.md). Re-check on the morning of posting.

post.en: In 2024 Finland passed a temporary border law for one year. It has never been used. In 2025 it was extended to the end of 2026. Now the government proposes two more years, unchanged, and a parliamentary committee has agreed; the plenary vote is still to come. When does temporary end? #Finland #law
post.fi: Suomi sääti vuonna 2024 väliaikaisen rajalain vuodeksi. Sitä ei ole koskaan käytetty. Vuonna 2025 sitä jatkettiin vuoden 2026 loppuun. Nyt hallitus esittää kaksi vuotta lisää sisältö ennallaan, ja perustuslakivaliokunta puolsi; täysistunnon äänestys on vielä edessä. Milloin väliaikainen loppuu?
post.ja: フィンランドは2024年、期限1年の一時的な国境法を制定した。一度も使われていない。2025年に2026年末まで延長。今度は内容そのままで2年の延長が提案され、議会の委員会が了承した。本会議の採決はこれから。一時的は、いつ終わる？
